items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: there was a guy named Freddie Slee had drums, and I used to fool around with his drums.

ctx.x: Oh, I was just a kid. I was -- I guess I was 15, 14, 15. When I first left Savannah I fooled around with so many instruments. But around Savannah I had picked up a trumpet and fooled around with that a lot, more than I did with trombone. And I didn't own any instrument.

Then I used to fool around -- there was a guy named Freddie Slee had drums, and I used to fool around with his drums. And he was a pretty bad drummer too. He couldn't play good. But he had drums, you know.
Do you remember how old you were when you first started fooling around with the trumpet?
